intents.name: technologies
intents.answer:
• Here's the stack we build with:
• *Frontend Technologies:* React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
• *Backend Technologies:* Node.js, Python (FastAPI/Django), Golang, Laravel and .NET Core
• *AI & Machine Learning:* OpenAI (GPT-4/GPT-5 APIs), LangChain, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, Vertex AI (Google Cloud AI), Azure OpenAI and IBM
• *Mobile Development:* iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), React Native and Flutter
• *Databases & Data Platforms:* PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Firebase, Snowflake, BigQuery and Redis
• Tell us what you're building and we'll match the right stack for it.

intents.name: benefits
intents.answer:
1. Learning and skill development

Employee reviews from interns mention supportive mentors, guidance from senior team members, and opportunities to learn through practical projects. 


2. Exposure to different technologies

The company works in areas including web and mobile development, AI, digital marketing, cloud infrastructure, and business communication platforms. The value to you depends on your role and project assignment. 

3. Career growth opportunities

Its careers page lists roles across technical support, testing, UI/UX design, IT management, sales, HR, and other functions. This may offer opportunities to develop your skills and move into more specialized roles. 

4. Mentorship and team experience

Some recent interns have praised the guidance they receive and the learning environment. Experiences are not uniform, so the quality of support may vary by team and manager. 

5. Experience with a range of business sectors

Leeway Softech serves areas such as banking, education, government, and hospitality. Depending on your assignment, this can help you understand how technology supports real business operations.
